rides.title: 2 Days of Sport - Sunday Social Run
rides.description:
Søndag fortsætter vi 2 Days of Sport med et social run. 
Vi deler igen op i to pacegrupper – 5:30 og 6:30 min/km – og løber samlet fra Copenhagen Cycling Club.

Ruten tager os ud på lange stræk af rolige og uforstyrrede veje og er lagt op som et social run med plads til både snak og gode kilometer. Et run skabt til at samle kilometer, finde rytmen og afslutte weekenden i godt selskab.

Husk at medbringe gode vibes.

Når vi er tilbage, er der snacks fra Kcal, mulighed for at købe kaffe og sodavand – og tid til at hænge ud med andre ryttere og løbere. 
Derudover kan du opleve og teste produkter fra Puronia, Sloe, Good Habit Company og Pine Athletic Skincare.

Meeting point: Copenhagen Cycling Club
 Meet up: 11:00 
Start: 11:10ish 
Distance: ~6 km
 Pace groups: 5:30 min/km · 6:30 min/km 
Surface: Asfalt
—
English
Join us for a social run.
On Sunday, we continue 2 Days of Sport with another social run. We’ll once again split into two pace groups – 5:30 and 6:30 min/km – and start together from Copenhagen Cycling Club.

The route takes us onto long stretches of quiet and uninterrupted roads and is designed as a social run with room for conversations and quality kilometres. A run designed to collect kilometres, settle into the rhythm and finish the weekend in good company.

Bring good vibes.

Back at the club there will be snacks from Kcal, coffee and soft drinks available to purchase, and time to hang out with fellow riders and runners. 
You’ll also get the chance to explore and test products from Puronia, Sloe, Good Habit Company and Pine Athletic Skincare.

Meeting point: Copenhagen Cycling Club 
Meet up: 11:00 Start: 11:10ish
 Distance: ~6 km 
Pace groups: 5:30 min/km · 6:30 min/km
 Surface: Tarmac

rides.title: Hybrid Social x Davinci Cykler – Cycling Workshop
DIRTY MIDSUMMER | AMAGER SOCIAL | GRAVEL BEERS N BONFIRE 🔥 ☀️
rides.description:
Hey all,

Let’s celebrate the longest day of the year the Dirty Tuesday way. Gravel, good company and making the most of the endless summer nights. 

We ride earlier and further than usual and grab a pizza slice and sixpack on our return to the bonfire at Islands Brygge/Kalvebod Brygge at 9pm. 

What to expect:
Hill sprint at Herstedhøje and ‘stram kæde’

Details:
Meet up 16:50 - Roll out 17:00
Tempo 25 - Distance 50km +/-
2 flats on the house (find your own way)
Remember plugs, Co2 & energy.
You must be able to ride 50k at 25k avg. 
We ride in 10-12 pax groups in same tempo.
Cancellation protocol: < 5 riders & heavy rain 

We look forward to riding dirt with you and wrap it up with bonfire & beers at Islands Brygge 🔥☀️

Team Dirty Tuesday

rides.title: Women's Intermediate
rides.description:
Join us on June 25th for this Women’s Intermediate ride led by our team of Rapha Ride Leaders; Lola, Olivia, Signe & Nora. 

If you’re experienced in a group ride setting and looking for a faster ride then this intermediate ride is for you. These rides will take place with an average speed of 28-30kmh. 

We will ride at a pace of 28-30kmh average. Please ensure you have knowledge of the common hand and voice signals before joining. 

Please remember to bring inner tubes, CO2 cartridges, water and snacks for the ride. Please also download the route onto your computer in advance.

Flat pedals, TT bikes and mountain bikes are not permitted on this ride. 

Meet-up: 17:00 at the Rapha Copenhagen Clubhouse (Kristen Bernikows Gade 7)
Departure: 17:15
Pace: 28-30kmh

We look forward to riding with you! 

If you can no longer join this ride, we kindly ask you to leave the ride on Strava so we can open your spot up to the next rider.

rides.title: Road Ride
rides.description:
Join us for our Long Road Ride — a longer endurance ride, with a high tempo. Depending on numbers of participents we will split up in two groups. Riders will rotate turns at the front throughout the ride. Always download the route to your headunit. Target average speed: 32–34 km/h. Participants should be comfortable riding in a group and familiar with standard hand and verbal signals. We usually finish at the shop for a drink or something to eat. 

If you have any questions please reach out. Looking forward seeing you!

Meeting Point: Århusgade 126, 2150 Nordhavn
Meeting time: 09.15
Start time: 09.30
Distance: 100-120 km +/-
Pace: 32- 34 km/h
Surface: Road
____________________
Bring a spare tube/plugs/tools, ride food and hydration. For everyone's safety, please obey all traffic lights and signs. If you have any questions do not hesitate to ask the rider leader at the event. And please download the route before the ride. Please "attend" if you intend to join the event.

rides.title: CCC JORDNÆR (Gravel)
rides.description:
A true classic heading from CCC through the beautiful northern sealand terrain visiting the volunteers driven café Jordnær in Gadevang for a coffee stop before finishing the route approx 100.k 

Meet up 09:15 
Roll out 09:30 

We head out in two groups 1 tempo 26-28 kph/avg and 1 moderate 24-25 kph/avg

This is a no drop ride, but you need to be able to keep the pace of the group you choose. 

Two punctures on the house rule in full effect - more, and you need to find your way home han-solo. 

Bring energy, wear a helmet and a smile. 

Let’s hit the trails together. 

Team CCC

rides.title: Women's Social Ride x Pizza
rides.description:
Join us for a Women's Social Ride and Pizza in the store after the ride. We will ride together all the way and change taking turns at the front along the route. We will clearly go through how to ride in a group and which signals we are using before heading out, if anyone is new. We expect you have click pedals, are capable of sitting on someone's wheel, and can handle your bike safely. Please make sure to download the route to your cycling computer, or ask the store staff or rideleader for help in advance.

It cost 100 DKK, if you wan't to join for Pizza in the store after the ride. You can pay at the desk before heading out on the ride. It is possible to leave a bag in the store. If you have any questions always reach out to our rideleaders or come by the store.
Looking forward to see you!

Meeting Point: Århusgade 126, 2150 Nordhavn
Meeting time: 17.00
Start time: 17.15
Distance: 55 km +/-
Pace: 26-28 km/h +/-
Surface: Road
____________________
Bring a spare tube/plugs/tools, ride food and hydration. For everyone's safety, please obey all traffic lights and signs. If you have any questions do not hesitate to ask the rider leader at the event. And please download the route before the ride. Please "attend" if you intend to join the event. If you have any questions do not hesitate to contact us via copenhagen@pasnormalstudios.com

rides.title: Women’s weekly gravel training - ice cream edition ✨
rides.description:
Last ride before summerbreak! There will be Hansen Is ice cream and “snik-snak” at 17:00 at the klub before we head out at 17:30 🍦Bring you trainingpartner or a good friend ✨

Remember to bring snacks, spare parts and good vibes🫶🏻

*****************************************
Meeting point: Klubben aka Copenhagen Cycling Club
Meet up: 17:20
Roll-out: 17:30
Distance: aprox. 60km
Pace: +/- 25-26 km/h
Surface: gravel 

See you for a fun training 
// Caroline & Julie

rides.title: Berlin to Copenhagen - Gravel Edition - Part of Nordic Chase 2026 (Ultra Cycling Series)
rides.description:
The Nordic Chase is expanding!
We’re launching a brand-new race in 2026: Berlin → Copenhagen.

For this race we are partnering with Standert as host partner in Berlin.

This gravel route takes riders through Germany and Denmark, covering historic towns, rolling farmland, forests, and scenic gravel paths — finishing in the heart of Copenhagen.

🔘 Official Dotwatcher.cc event
📍 Live tracking via FollowMyChallenge.com

Registrations are open:
👉 www.nordicchase.com
(limited capacity at 100 riders)

Registration includes:
1. Rider briefing and Pasta Party @Standert Bicycles (store in Berlin)
2. Official Race Manual with the race details
3. Race cap and other goodies
4. Live GPS tracking
5. Finisher Certificate
6. Post-ride ceremony with drinks in Copenhagen
7. Photos taken by our media team
8. Entry to WhatsApp group chat to connect other riders
9. Small bag transfer rom the start to the finish

All info is on www.nordicchase.com

Questions, then email to info@nordicchase.com

Please note: The final route and exact start location in Berlin will be provided in the race manual. The current route is a draft and will be verified by the organizer. The manual will be emailed to all registered participants three weeks before the race.

rides.title: Copenhagen to Oslo - Gravel Edition - Part of Nordic Chase 2026 (Ultra Cycling Series)
rides.description:
🌲 Nordic Chase – Gravel Edition 2026 🚴‍♀️
Copenhagen → Oslo | Self-Supported Ultra-Distance Race

The Nordic Chase returns in 2026!

This Strava event is for the Gravel Edition, taking riders on a wild and scenic journey from Copenhagen to Oslo, crossing Denmark, Sweden, and Norway through remote gravel paths, dense forests, serene meadows, and untouched Nordic wilderness.

🔘 Official Dotwatcher.cc event
📍 Live tracking via FollowMyChallenge.com

🌍 Full route details and event schedule will be posted on:
👉 www.nordicchase.com/gravel

Registrations are now full — we’ve reached our limit of 100 riders.

For more information, please visit www.nordicchase.com or contact us at info@nordicchase.com

Please note that the final route and exact start location will be provided in the race manual.

The race manual will be shared by email with all registered participants. The race manual is scheduled for release on July 23rd, 2026.
